method: Directly visually viewed all seven teaching images and D03/D04 manuscript-only image. Compared target characters and manuscript surroundings; also compared source image object identities.
finding: No identical crop or target-character overlap observed. Teaching prose does not provide D answer. D03 and D04 themselves share one target character, so are two manuscript instances but not two independent lexical categories.
limitation: This confirms specified packet separation, not a filesystem access audit or proof of reader lifetime non-exposure.
